caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden clock with a dark reddish-brown frame and a decorative arched top. The clock face is located in the upper section and is predominantly off-white with large black Arabic numerals arranged in a circular pattern. The clock face also features black hour and minute hands, smaller golden decorative elements, and a couple of concentric circles in gold. Around the corners of the clock face, there are gold and orange scrollwork patterns set against a reddish background. The lower section of the clock consists of a rectangular panel with a blueish-white reflective surface, possibly meant to represent glass or a mirror. On both sides of the clock, there are vertical columns with a darker brown or black tone and subtle gold detailing. The overall composition centers the clock against a plain, light beige background. There is a signature at the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Mantle Clock
